configurations.missing_pairs_note: Counts use the full ANTENNA table and observed triangular orientation. Omitted pairs may be intentional; no absent records are replaced by flags. Mixed orientations have no inferred full domain.

layout.channel_presence_note: Per-cell dimensions were compared with spectral-window metadata. Unrecorded channels beyond that metadata cannot be inferred.
layout.validation_scope: Inspection only. This is not an MS conformance or CASA compatibility certification.

uvw.note: Logical dictionary estimate only; no measured archive savings. Only identical bytes are shareable. No UVW regeneration or wavelength conversion was performed.

DATA.note: Flagged samples and nonfinite samples are excluded from valid counts; original values have not been changed.

storage.note: File lengths and allocated blocks measured on the local filesystem, excluding directory inodes. Storage-manager file assignment is by table.f<SEQNR> naming; shared files cannot be allocated exactly to individual columns.

policies.source_access: readonly/usernoread; requires a frozen input copy
policies.inspection_scan: All defined values, all rows; no sampling
policies.numeric_metadata_encoding: dtype + shape + base64 raw C-order bytes; values are a human-readable preview
policies.logical_string_bytes: UTF-8 value lengths; excludes Python or container overhead
policies.noise_model: None validated; WEIGHT/SIGMA do not imply a thermal-noise guarantee
policies.archive_status: No encoding, decoding, quantization or scientific-fidelity tests implemented in this milestone
